messages:
maria.sales: Starting POC scoping thread for OrionTelco - they need EU-only residency, DPA addendum, SOC2 artefacts, and a pen-test window. Also asking about pilot pricing and success metrics.
thomas.se: Use case: replace manual routing assistant. They want 30% time savings and suggestion acceptance >=65%. Will provide 200 labelled prompts for evals.
anya.sec: We can provide SOC2 Type II summary and subprocessor list. DPA will include EU data residency clause. Pen-test: allowed only in customer VPC, approved vendors, 72h notice, and requires PO + SOW.
kevin.eng: For latency targets, which model and quantization? Private VPC affects perf. Recommend rwd-medium int8 for p99 around 300ms on short prompts. Need 5 business days for provisioning.
maria.sales: Customer prefers Private VPC. Proposed pilot fee 12k for 12 weeks incl. small dedicated pool + 2 onboarding days; overage billed per token. Finance to confirm.
thomas.se: Acceptance checklist we expect to validate:
- 200 evals meet accuracy threshold
- latency p99 <=300ms for single-turn prompts
- no PII exposure in outputs
- pen-test completed with low/medium findings fixed
If any fail, fallback to hosted canary.
kevin.eng: We'll add a prewarm step (1k synthetic sessions) to populate KV cache and provide an eval harness docker command.
anya.sec: Add runbook constraints for pen-test (no host/control-plane attacks, no social engineering). Findings to be submitted to Redwood security first.
ops-bot: INF-4999 created for VPC provisioning, assigned to kevin.eng. ETA 5 business days.
maria.sales: Action items assigned - I'll draft SOW and send DPA to legal; @anya.sec to attach SOC2 summary and subprocessors by Monday. Closing for now and will post SOW draft when ready.
